label: prf:coulomb-strong-ratio-q-rational
title: Proof of coulomb strong ratio q rational
html:
The proof has two steps:

  1. Algebraic identity: for any real q \ne 0,

      \frac{q - q^{-1}}{q + q^{-1}} = \frac{q^2 - 1}{q^2 + 1}.

    Clearing denominators reduces it to a polynomial identity.

  2. Transcendental bridge: for any real q > 0,

      \tanh(\ln q) = \frac{q - q^{-1}}{q + q^{-1}}.

    Follows from e^{\ln q} = q and the definitions of \sinh, \cosh, \tanh.

The composite (Coulomb/strong ratio \tanh(\ln q) is the q-rational (q^2-1)/(q^2+1)) is the immediate corollary: \tanh(\ln q) = (q^2-1)/(q^2+1) for q > 0.

q-usage discipline

The identity is stated and proved over \mathbb{R}_{>0} (the archimedean substrate-anchor regime). The fibre-level q-rational form (q-q^{-1})/(q+q^{-1}) is a Laurent-polynomial ratio over \mathbb{Z}[q,q^{-1}], realised at q = q_0 \in \mathbb{R}_{>0} where it agrees with the archimedean \tanh(\ln q_0). There is no |q| = 1 step (the identity involves q^{-1} algebraically, not as conjugation; both q_0 and q_0^{-1} are real positive points). Compliant with the requirement that q_0 have vanishing imaginary part.
